# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Packages <- c("readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "Biobase","ComplexHeatmap", "limma", "tidyverse", "ropls", "cowplot", "UpSetR")

lapply(Packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r source_functions, include=FALSE}
source("functions.R")
source("missingness_visualization_functions.R")
```

## Load Dataset(s)

```{r LoadDataset, include=FALSE}
batch2_peak_area           <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_peak_area_values.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
batch2_compound_annotation <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_metabolite_annotations.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
batch2_sample_metadata     <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/Batch2_sample_metadata.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Build Full ExpressionSet

```{r prep_dataframe}
final_matrix <- batch2_peak_area %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Sample"))

compounds_in_peak <- unique(batch2_peak_area$Compound.ID)

batch2_compound_annotation <- batch2_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% compounds_in_peak) %>%
  arrange(match(Name, rownames(final_matrix)))

metabolite_names <- batch2_compound_annotation$Name
final_matrix     <- apply(final_matrix, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(final_matrix) <- metabolite_names

batch2_sample_metadata <- batch2_sample_metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(final_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, colnames(final_matrix)))

sample_metadata_df           <- as.data.frame(batch2_sample_metadata)
rownames(sample_metadata_df) <- sample_metadata_df$Sample
sample_phenoData             <- AnnotatedDataFrame(sample_metadata_df)

metabolite_metadata_df           <- as.data.frame(batch2_compound_annotation)
rownames(metabolite_metadata_df) <- metabolite_metadata_df$Name
metabolite_featureData           <- AnnotatedDataFrame(metabolite_metadata_df)

batch2_metabolomics <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData   = final_matrix,
  phenoData   = sample_phenoData,
  featureData = metabolite_featureData
)
```

```{r log_transform}
exprs(batch2_metabolomics) <- log2(exprs(batch2_metabolomics) + 1)
cat("Log2 transformation applied.\n")
cat("Intensity range after:", range(exprs(batch2_metabolomics), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

---

# Define Neurotransmitter Subgroups
```{r define_subgroups}
annotation_full <- fData(batch2_metabolomics)

# --- Strict: canonical small-molecule neurotransmitters only ---
# Source: Hyman SE (2005) Current Biology 15(5):R154-R158, Box 1
# Includes: monoamines, acetylcholine, L-amino acid NTs, D-serine
# Excludes: peptide NTs (require peptidomics), gases (NO/CO, not LC-MS detectable)
# Adenosine and endocannabinoids excluded from strict; included in broad only
strict_keywords <- paste(
  "acetylcholine",
  "dopamine",
  "norepinephrine", "noradrenaline",
  "epinephrine", "adrenaline",
  "serotonin", "5-hydroxytryptamine",
  "histamine",
  "glutamate", "glutamic acid",
  "aspartate", "aspartic acid",
  "gamma.aminobutyric", "GABA",
  "glycine",
  "D-serine",
  sep = "|"
)

# Exclude precursors/metabolites that share root strings with the above
strict_exclusions <- "glutamine|homoglutamic|asparagine|kynurenine|kynurenic|histidine|histidinol"

strict_names <- annotation_full %>%
  filter(grepl(strict_keywords, Name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!grepl(strict_exclusions, Name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Name)

# --- Broad: strict + precursors + downstream metabolites + adenosine + endocannabinoids ---
# Precursors:   tryptophan, tyrosine, L-DOPA, phenylalanine, choline, glutamine
# Metabolites:  5-HIAA, homovanillic, vanillylmandelic, DOPAC, 3-methoxytyramine,
#               normetanephrine, metanephrine, kynurenine pathway
# Purines:      adenosine (ATP excluded - unstable, typically lost in LC-MS)
# Lipid NTs:    anandamide, 2-arachidonoylglycerol (endocannabinoids, detectable on C18/C8)
broad_extra_keywords <- paste(
  "tryptophan", "tyrosine", "phenylalanine",
  "L-DOPA", "levodopa", "dihydroxyphenylalanine",
  "choline",
  "glutamine",
  "5-hydroxyindoleacetic", "5-HIAA",
  "homovanillic", "vanillylmandelic",
  "dihydroxyphenylacetic", "DOPAC",
  "3-methoxytyramine", "normetanephrine", "metanephrine",
  "kynurenine", "kynurenic",
  "adenosine",
  "anandamide", "arachidonoylglycerol", "arachidonoylethanolamide",
  sep = "|"
)

broad_names <- annotation_full %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(strict_keywords, broad_extra_keywords, sep = "|"),
               Name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!grepl(strict_exclusions, Name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
           grepl(broad_extra_keywords, Name, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(Name)

cat("=== Neurotransmitter Subgroup Sizes ===\n")
cat("Strict (canonical small-molecule NTs):", length(strict_names), "compounds\n")
cat("Broad  (+ precursors/metabolites/adenosine/endocannabinoids):", length(broad_names), "compounds\n\n")

cat("--- Strict compounds found ---\n")
annotation_full %>%
  filter(Name %in% strict_names) %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, Sub.Class, Class) %>%
  arrange(Sub.Class, Name) %>%
  print()

cat("\n--- Broad-only additions ---\n")
annotation_full %>%
  filter(Name %in% broad_names & !Name %in% strict_names) %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, Sub.Class, Class) %>%
  arrange(Sub.Class, Name) %>%
  print()
```

```{r build_esets}
subset_eset <- function(eset, names_keep) {
  idx <- featureNames(eset) %in% names_keep
  eset[idx, ]
}

eset_broad  <- subset_eset(batch2_metabolomics, broad_names)
eset_strict <- subset_eset(batch2_metabolomics, strict_names)

analyses_list <- list(broad = eset_broad, strict = eset_strict)

cat("ExpressionSet sizes:\n")
cat("  Broad: ", nrow(eset_broad),  "features x", ncol(eset_broad),  "samples\n")
cat("  Strict:", nrow(eset_strict), "features x", ncol(eset_strict), "samples\n")
```

---

# Analyses (Looped over Broad and Strict)

```{r main_loop}
for (scope in names(analyses_list)) {
  
  eset <- analyses_list[[scope]]
  
  # Output paths scoped by broad/strict
  png_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_neurotransmitters", scope)
  svg_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_neurotransmitters", scope, "svg")
  csv_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_neurotransmitters", scope, "csv")
  dir.create(png_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(svg_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(csv_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("SCOPE:", toupper(scope), "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  n_features <- nrow(eset)
  cat("Compounds in this subgroup:", n_features, "\n\n")
  
  if (n_features == 0) {
    cat("No compounds found for scope:", scope, "- skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Dynamic plot height: 0.35 inches per compound, minimum 8
  bar_height <- max(8, n_features * 0.35)

  # ── Compound Inventory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("--- Compound Inventory ---\n")
  inventory <- fData(eset) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, Sub.Class, Class) %>%
    arrange(Sub.Class, Name)
  print(inventory)
  write_csv(inventory,
            file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_inventory.csv")))
  
  metadata_loop <- pData(eset)
  GW            <- metadata_loop$GW
  sex_groups    <- metadata_loop$Sex
  
  # ── GW Correlation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- GW Correlation ---\n")
  
  correlation_test <- function(x, y) {
    result <- cor.test(x, y)
    c(correlation = result$estimate, p_value = result$p.value)
  }
  
  gw_corr_stats <- data.frame(
    Name = fData(eset)$Name,
    GW_corr_pval = t(apply(exprs(eset), 1, function(x) correlation_test(x, GW)))
  ) %>%
    mutate(GW_FDR = p.adjust(GW_corr_pval.p_value, method = "fdr"))
  
  gw_corr_all <- gw_corr_stats %>%
    mutate(
      Name_display = truncate_labels(Name),
      FDR_label    = case_when(
        GW_FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        GW_FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
        GW_FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE           ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  scatter_GW <- ggplot(gw_corr_all,
                       aes(x = reorder(Name_display, GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor),
                           y = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor)) +
    geom_point(aes(size  = -log10(GW_corr_pval.p_value),
                   color = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = FDR_label,
                  y     = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor + 0.03),
              size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "tomato", mid = "grey90", high = "steelblue",
                          midpoint = 0, name = "Correlation") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x     = "Compound",
         y     = "Correlation with GW",
         title = paste0("GW Correlations - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")"),
         size  = "-log10(p)") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  save_dual_format(scatter_GW, paste0("gw_correlation_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                   label_lookup = build_label_lookup(gw_corr_all$Name))
  print(scatter_GW)
  write_csv(gw_corr_stats,
            file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_gw_correlation.csv")))
  
  # ── GW limma ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- GW limma ---\n")
  
  design_gw        <- model.matrix(~ GW, data = metadata_loop)
  fit_gw           <- lmFit(exprs(eset), design_gw)
  fit_gw           <- eBayes(fit_gw)
  gw_limma_results <- topTable(fit_gw, coef = "GW", number = Inf,
                                adjust.method = "BH") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
    left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
              by = "Name") %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Increases with GW", "Decreases with GW"),
      FDR_label = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        adj.P.Val < 0.01  ~ "**",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE              ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  cat("GW limma - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(gw_limma_results$P.Value < 0.05), "\n")
  cat("GW limma - FDR < 0.05:",       sum(gw_limma_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
  
  gw_bar_data <- gw_limma_results %>%
    arrange(logFC) %>%
    mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))
  
  gw_bar <- ggplot(gw_bar_data,
                   aes(x = reorder(Name_display, logFC), y = logFC, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = FDR_label,
                  hjust = ifelse(logFC > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
              size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increases with GW" = "steelblue",
                                  "Decreases with GW" = "tomato")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x       = "Compound",
         y       = "Slope (log2 peak area per GW week)",
         title   = paste0("GW-Associated Neurotransmitters - limma (", scope, ")"),
         caption = "* FDR < 0.05   ** FDR < 0.01   *** FDR < 0.001") +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
  
  save_dual_format(gw_bar, paste0("gw_limma_bar_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                   height = bar_height,
                   label_lookup = build_label_lookup(gw_bar_data$Name))
  print(gw_bar)
  write_csv(gw_limma_results,
            file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_gw_limma.csv")))
  
  # ── Sex Wilcoxon ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- Sex Wilcoxon ---\n")
  
  wilcoxon_test <- function(x, sex) {
    valid_idx <- !is.na(x)
    x_clean   <- x[valid_idx]
    sex_clean <- sex[valid_idx]
    if (length(unique(sex_clean)) < 2)
      return(c(statistic = NA, p_value = NA))
    result <- wilcox.test(x_clean[sex_clean == "F"],
                          x_clean[sex_clean == "M"],
                          exact = FALSE)
    c(statistic = as.numeric(result$statistic), p_value = result$p.value)
  }
  
  wilcoxon_results <- t(apply(exprs(eset), 1, wilcoxon_test, sex = sex_groups))
  colnames(wilcoxon_results) <- c("statistic", "p_value")
  
  mean_male   <- apply(exprs(eset)[, sex_groups == "M", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_female <- apply(exprs(eset)[, sex_groups == "F", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  metabolite_sex_stats <- data.frame(
    Name               = fData(eset)$Name,
    Compound.ID        = fData(eset)$Compound.ID,
    Wilcoxon_statistic = wilcoxon_results[, "statistic"],
    p_value            = wilcoxon_results[, "p_value"],
    Mean_Female        = mean_female,
    Mean_Male          = mean_male,
    logFC              = log2(mean_male / mean_female)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      FDR                    = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
      Bonferroni             = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
      Significant_FDR        = FDR < 0.05,
      Significant_Bonferroni = Bonferroni < 0.05,
      Direction              = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ "Higher in Males",
        logFC < 0 ~ "Higher in Females",
        TRUE      ~ "No difference"
      ),
      Name_display = truncate_labels(Name)
    )
  
  sig_metabolites_fdr <- metabolite_sex_stats %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)
  
  cat("Sex Wilcoxon - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(metabolite_sex_stats$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Sex Wilcoxon - FDR < 0.05:",       sum(metabolite_sex_stats$Significant_FDR, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  volcano_FDR <- ggplot(metabolite_sex_stats, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(p_value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Significant_FDR), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sig_metabolites_fdr,
                    aes(label = Name_display),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
                       name = "FDR < 0.05") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,            linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x     = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
         y     = "-log10(p-value)",
         title = paste0("Sex Differential - Volcano (FDR) - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  save_dual_format(volcano_FDR, paste0("sex_volcano_FDR_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                   label_lookup = build_label_lookup(metabolite_sex_stats$Name))
  print(volcano_FDR)
  
  volcano_Bonferroni <- ggplot(metabolite_sex_stats, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(p_value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Significant_Bonferroni), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sig_metabolites_fdr,
                    aes(label = Name_display),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
                       name = "Bonferroni < 0.05") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,            linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x     = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
         y     = "-log10(p-value)",
         title = paste0("Sex Differential - Volcano (Bonferroni) - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  save_dual_format(volcano_Bonferroni, paste0("sex_volcano_Bonferroni_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                   label_lookup = build_label_lookup(metabolite_sex_stats$Name))
  print(volcano_Bonferroni)
  write_csv(metabolite_sex_stats,
            file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_sex_wilcoxon.csv")))
  
  # ── Sex limma ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- Sex limma ---\n")
  
  metadata_limma      <- pData(eset)
  metadata_limma$Sex  <- factor(metadata_limma$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
  design_sex          <- model.matrix(~ Sex, data = metadata_limma)
  
  fit_sex           <- lmFit(exprs(eset), design_sex)
  fit_sex           <- eBayes(fit_sex)
  sex_limma_results <- topTable(fit_sex, coef = "SexM", number = Inf,
                                 adjust.method = "BH") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
    left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
              by = "Name") %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Higher in Males", "Higher in Females"),
      FDR_label = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        adj.P.Val < 0.01  ~ "**",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE              ~ ""
      )
    )
  
  cat("Sex limma - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(sex_limma_results$P.Value < 0.05), "\n")
  cat("Sex limma - FDR < 0.05:",       sum(sex_limma_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")
  
  volcano_sex_limma <- ggplot(sex_limma_results,
                               aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = adj.P.Val < 0.05), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = sex_limma_results %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05),
                    aes(label = truncate_labels(Name)),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
                       name = "FDR < 0.05") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,            linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x       = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
         y       = "-log10(p-value)",
         title   = paste0("Sex Differential - limma Volcano - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")"),
         caption = "Positive logFC = higher in males") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  
  save_dual_format(volcano_sex_limma, paste0("sex_limma_volcano_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
  print(volcano_sex_limma)
  
  sex_bar_data <- sex_limma_results %>%
    arrange(logFC) %>%
    mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))
  
  sex_bar <- ggplot(sex_bar_data,
                    aes(x = reorder(Name_display, logFC), y = logFC, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = FDR_label,
                  hjust = ifelse(logFC > 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
              size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Higher in Males"   = "steelblue",
                                  "Higher in Females" = "tomato")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x       = "Compound",
         y       = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
         title   = paste0("Sex-Differential Neurotransmitters - limma (", scope, ")"),
         caption = "* FDR < 0.05   ** FDR < 0.01   *** FDR < 0.001") +
    theme(plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
  
  save_dual_format(sex_bar, paste0("sex_limma_bar_", scope),
                   png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                   height = bar_height,
                   label_lookup = build_label_lookup(sex_bar_data$Name))
  print(sex_bar)
  write_csv(sex_limma_results,
            file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_sex_limma.csv")))
  
  # ── Trajectory Plots - All Compounds ────────────────────────────────────────
  # ── Trajectory Plots - Nominally Significant Compounds ──────────────────────
  traj_labels <- sex_limma_results %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, P.Value, adj.P.Val, logFC) %>%
    rename(sex_p = P.Value, sex_fdr = adj.P.Val) %>%
    left_join(
      gw_limma_results %>% dplyr::select(Name, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
        rename(gw_p = P.Value, gw_fdr = adj.P.Val),
      by = "Name"
    ) %>%
    filter(sex_p < 0.05 | gw_p < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(traj_label = paste0(
      "Sex FDR=", formatC(sex_fdr, format = "e", digits = 2),
      "  logFC=", round(logFC, 3),
      "  |  GW FDR=", formatC(gw_fdr, format = "e", digits = 2)
    ))

  cat("\n--- Trajectory Plots (", nrow(traj_labels), "nominally significant compounds) ---\n")

  if (nrow(traj_labels) > 0) {
    traj_plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(traj_labels)), function(i) {
      plot_trajectory(traj_labels$Name[i], eset = eset,
                      title_suffix = traj_labels$traj_label[i])
    })
    save_trajectory_grids(traj_plots, paste0("trajectories_", scope), png_path, svg_path)
  } else {
    cat("No nominally significant compounds to plot.\n")
  }
  
  # ── PLS-DA (guard: need >= 2 features and adequate group sizes) ──────────────
  cat("\n--- PLS-DA ---\n")
  
  plsda_matrix   <- t(exprs(eset))
  sex_labels     <- factor(pData(eset)$Sex)
  min_group_size <- min(table(sex_labels))
  safe_ncomp     <- min(5, min_group_size - 1, n_features - 1)
  
  if (safe_ncomp < 1) {
    cat("Skipping PLS-DA: insufficient features or group size for scope =", scope, "\n")
  } else {
    plsda_matrix_imputed <- apply(plsda_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)
    
    cat("Group sizes:", table(sex_labels), "\n")
    cat("Using ncomp =", safe_ncomp, "\n")
    
    set.seed(42)
    plsda_fit <- opls(
      x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
      y         = sex_labels,
      predI     = safe_ncomp,
      orthoI    = 0,
      permI     = 0,
      fig.pdfC  = "none",
      info.txtC = "none"
    )
    
    plsda_scores <- data.frame(
      Comp1 = plsda_fit@scoreMN[, 1],
      Comp2 = if (safe_ncomp >= 2) plsda_fit@scoreMN[, 2] else 0,
      Sex   = sex_labels
    )
    
    score_plot <- ggplot(plsda_scores, aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2, color = Sex)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "tomato", "M" = "steelblue")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x = "Component 1", y = "Component 2",
           title = paste0("PLS-DA Score Plot - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    save_dual_format(score_plot, paste0("sex_plsda_scores_", scope),
                     png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
    print(score_plot)
    
    vip_df <- data.frame(
      Name      = colnames(plsda_matrix_imputed),
      VIP_comp1 = as.numeric(getVipVn(plsda_fit))
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(VIP_comp1)) %>%
      left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
                by = "Name") %>%
      mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))
    
    vip_plot <- ggplot(vip_df, aes(x = reorder(Name_display, VIP_comp1), y = VIP_comp1)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      coord_flip() +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x       = "Compound",
           y       = "VIP Score (Component 1)",
           title   = paste0("PLS-DA VIP Scores - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")"),
           caption = "Red dashed line = VIP > 1") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    save_dual_format(vip_plot, paste0("sex_plsda_vip_", scope),
                     png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                     height = bar_height,
                     label_lookup = build_label_lookup(vip_df$Name))
    print(vip_plot)
    write_csv(vip_df,
              file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_plsda_vip.csv")))
    
    # PLS-DA permutation
    set.seed(42)
    plsda_perm <- opls(
      x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
      y         = sex_labels,
      predI     = safe_ncomp,
      orthoI    = 0,
      permI     = 100,
      fig.pdfC  = "none",
      info.txtC = "none"
    )
    cat("\nPLS-DA permutation results:\n")
    print(plsda_perm@summaryDF)
    
    # ── OPLS-DA (requires >= 2 features) ──────────────────────────────────────
    if (n_features >= 2) {
      cat("\n--- OPLS-DA ---\n")
      
      set.seed(42)
      oplsda_fit <- opls(
        x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
        y         = sex_labels,
        predI     = 1,
        orthoI    = 1,
        permI     = 0,
        fig.pdfC  = "none",
        info.txtC = "none"
      )
      
      oplsda_scores <- data.frame(
        Predictive = oplsda_fit@scoreMN[, 1],
        Orthogonal = oplsda_fit@orthoScoreMN[, 1],
        Sex        = sex_labels
      )
      
      oplsda_score_plot <- ggplot(oplsda_scores,
                                   aes(x = Predictive, y = Orthogonal, color = Sex)) +
        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "tomato", "M" = "steelblue")) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(x     = "Predictive Component (sex-correlated variance)",
             y     = "Orthogonal Component (within-sex variance)",
             title = paste0("OPLS-DA Score Plot - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      
      save_dual_format(oplsda_score_plot, paste0("sex_oplsda_scores_", scope),
                       png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
      print(oplsda_score_plot)
      
      cov_vec <- apply(plsda_matrix_imputed, 2, function(x)
        cov(x, oplsda_fit@scoreMN[, 1]))
      cor_vec <- apply(plsda_matrix_imputed, 2, function(x)
        cor(x, oplsda_fit@scoreMN[, 1]))
      
      splot_df <- data.frame(
        Name        = colnames(plsda_matrix_imputed),
        Covariance  = cov_vec,
        Correlation = cor_vec
      ) %>%
        left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
                  by = "Name") %>%
        mutate(
          Reliable     = abs(Correlation) > 0.5,
          Name_display = truncate_labels(Name)
        )
      
      splot <- ggplot(splot_df, aes(x = Covariance, y = Correlation, color = Reliable)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
        geom_text_repel(aes(label = Name_display), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0,             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "steelblue"),
                           name = "|Correlation| > 0.5") +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(x       = "Covariance with Predictive Component",
             y       = "Correlation with Predictive Component",
             title   = paste0("OPLS-DA S-plot - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")"),
             caption = "Top-right: higher in females | Bottom-left: higher in males") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      
      save_dual_format(splot, paste0("sex_oplsda_splot_", scope),
                       png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path)
      print(splot)
      
      oplsda_vip_df <- data.frame(
        Name           = colnames(plsda_matrix_imputed),
        VIP_predictive = as.numeric(getVipVn(oplsda_fit))
      ) %>%
        arrange(desc(VIP_predictive)) %>%
        left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
                  by = "Name") %>%
        mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))
      
      oplsda_vip_plot <- ggplot(oplsda_vip_df,
                                 aes(x = reorder(Name_display, VIP_predictive),
                                     y = VIP_predictive)) +
        geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkorchid", alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
        coord_flip() +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(x       = "Compound",
             y       = "VIP Score (Predictive Component)",
             title   = paste0("OPLS-DA VIP Scores - Neurotransmitters (", scope, ")"),
             caption = "Red dashed line = VIP > 1") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      
      save_dual_format(oplsda_vip_plot, paste0("sex_oplsda_vip_", scope),
                       png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
                       height = bar_height,
                       label_lookup = build_label_lookup(oplsda_vip_df$Name))
      print(oplsda_vip_plot)
      
      write_csv(oplsda_vip_df,
                file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_oplsda_vip.csv")))
      write_csv(splot_df,
                file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_oplsda_splot.csv")))
      
      set.seed(42)
      oplsda_perm <- opls(
        x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
        y         = sex_labels,
        predI     = 1,
        orthoI    = 1,
        permI     = 100,
        fig.pdfC  = "none",
        info.txtC = "none"
      )
      cat("\nOPLS-DA permutation results:\n")
      print(oplsda_perm@summaryDF)
    }
  }
  
  # ── UpSet Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- UpSet Overlap ---\n")
  
  sex_wilcoxon_fdr     <- metabolite_sex_stats %>% filter(FDR < 0.05)                      %>% pull(Name)
  sex_wilcoxon_nominal <- metabolite_sex_stats %>% filter(p_value < 0.05 & FDR >= 0.05)    %>% pull(Name)
  sex_limma_fdr_hits   <- sex_limma_results   %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)                 %>% pull(Name)
  sex_limma_nominal    <- sex_limma_results   %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05 & adj.P.Val >= 0.05) %>% pull(Name)
  gw_corr_fdr          <- gw_corr_stats       %>% filter(GW_FDR < 0.05)                    %>% pull(Name)
  gw_limma_fdr_hits    <- gw_limma_results    %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05)                 %>% pull(Name)
  
  all_names <- unique(c(sex_wilcoxon_fdr, sex_wilcoxon_nominal,
                         sex_limma_fdr_hits, sex_limma_nominal,
                         gw_corr_fdr, gw_limma_fdr_hits))
  
  if (length(all_names) > 0) {
    upset_df <- data.frame(
      Name              = all_names,
      Sex_Wilcoxon_FDR  = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_wilcoxon_fdr),
      Sex_Wilcoxon_nom  = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_wilcoxon_nominal),
      Sex_limma_FDR     = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_limma_fdr_hits),
      Sex_limma_nom     = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_limma_nominal),
      GW_corr_FDR       = as.integer(all_names %in% gw_corr_fdr),
      GW_limma_FDR      = as.integer(all_names %in% gw_limma_fdr_hits)
    )
    
    png(file.path(png_path, paste0("upset_overlap_", scope, ".png")),
        width = 12, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
    upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
          order.by        = "freq",
          decreasing      = TRUE,
          main.bar.color  = "grey30",
          text.scale      = 1.3,
          mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
          sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method")
    dev.off()
    
    upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
          order.by        = "freq",
          decreasing      = TRUE,
          main.bar.color  = "grey30",
          text.scale      = 1.3,
          mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
          sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method")
    
    write_csv(upset_df,
              file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_nt_", scope, "_upset.csv")))
  } else {
    cat("No significant hits for UpSet plot in scope:", scope, "\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n--- Scope", toupper(scope), "complete ---\n\n")
}
```
